subject: School Committee Structure and Ward Representation
overview: The subcommittee deliberated on the composition and governance of the School Committee, reaching a preliminary consensus on ward-based representation and the Mayor's role. Members decided to seek feedback from the full committee on these recommendations before drafting formal charter revisions.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Accepted the minutes of the February 13, 2024, meeting.

items.title: Feedback from School Committee Stakeholders
items.summary: Facilitator Paulette Van der Kloot summarized feedback from current and former school committee members regarding term lengths, ward representation, and the Mayor's role as chair.

items.title: Vacancy Procedures and Recent Resignation
items.summary: The subcommittee discussed the lack of formal vacancy procedures in the current charter following a recent resignation and the necessity of codifying a replacement process.

items.title: Article 4: Ward vs. At-Large Representation
items.summary: Members debated whether ward-based representation would improve geographic equity or if at-large seats are preferable given the historical difficulty in recruiting candidates.

items.title: Discussion of Term Lengths and Election Logistics
items.summary: Milva McDonald outlined the administrative challenges the elections department faces with three-year terms, prompting the subcommittee to weigh the benefits of two-year versus four-year terms.

items.title: Consensus on Governance and Mayor's Role
items.summary: The subcommittee reached a consensus to recommend ward-based representation and the Mayor's continued membership on the committee, though members remained split on whether the Mayor should serve as chair.

items.title: Drafting Process and Committee Coordination
items.summary: Decided to present core recommendations on committee composition to the full Charter Study Committee for consensus before drafting specific language for Article 4.

items.title: Inter-branch Collaboration and Joint Meetings
items.summary: The subcommittee discussed proposing charter language to mandate periodic joint meetings between the City Council and School Committee to improve budget transparency and communication.
